title: Market-Structure / Rerating Route Candidate V2 — Realized System Flow
derivesFrom: Contrast between 2014 Stock Connect broker shadow and failed 2013 IPO-restart holdout; neither case may validate V2.
purpose: Test whether market-structure events can be underwritten before company quarterly conversion only when the changed rule/access is already producing observable system-level flows.

requiredLayers.name: qualifying_structure_event
requiredLayers.requirement: A rule/access/liquidity/capital-constraint change with direct mechanical economic incidence.

requiredLayers.name: quantified_company_baseline
requiredLayers.requirement: Pre-event company filing quantifies exposure through market share, business mix, balance-sheet sensitivity, transaction economics or capacity.

requiredLayers.name: realized_system_flow_conversion
requiredLayers.requirement: Before selection, independent data show actual turnover, transaction volume, fund flow, issuance, credit use, utilization, customer count or another system-level quantity changed materially under the new regime.

requiredLayers.name: net_incidence
requiredLayers.requirement: Major offsetting channels are identified and the expected net effect is directionally positive; a reopening that simultaneously drains another key profit pool is not enough.

requiredLayers.name: expectation_absorption
requiredLayers.requirement: Price/consensus absorption is measured and cannot be extreme without a fresh magnitude or duration reset.

note: These exclusions apply only to this exceptional pre-report route. The normal fundamental route remains unchanged and can later select the company once operating conversion is reported.
antiOverfit: Do not validate V2 on 2013 IPO restart or 2014 Stock Connect.
Do not hard-code brokers, exchanges or IPOs.
Do not treat equity-price momentum itself as system-flow conversion.
Do not infer realized usage from policy announcement language.

validationPlan.historical: Find an untouched window with a qualifying market-structure event and observable system flow before company results.
validationPlan.prospective: Apply unchanged to future 2026 weekly checkpoints.
